# Autoservice Bettenduerf

> Autosgarage (auto repair garage) in Bettendorf, Luxembourg, and official 1·2·3 AutoService partner garage. Independent workshop for all makes and models — service strictly by appointment. Site languages: Luxembourgish (default), German, French, English.

Autoservice Bettenduerf offers maintenance, repairs, tyre service, diagnostics, air-conditioning service, roadworthiness (Contrôle Technique) preparation, tuning and bodywork. Two highlighted specialisations: wheel alignment (Achsvermiessung) and gearbox flushing (Getriebespülung / Spullung vun der Boîte). Servicing follows manufacturer specifications so the manufacturer warranty is preserved.

## Contact
- Address: 63, rue de Diekirch-Echternach, L-9355 Bettendorf, Luxembourg
- Phone: +352 80 86 87 / +352 621 435 495
- Email: Autoservicebettenduerf@outlook.com
- Appointments only (no walk-in hours). Requests via the contact form or by phone.
